title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce System1-Arena, a benchmark that gives all models the same decision requests and scores their probabilities.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: It contains 92k questions across 105 tasks from 268 public sources, in four groups: text classification and knowledge, applied decisions, evaluation and control, and agent and action.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs in non-agentic accuracy, with better-calibrated probabilities at one-quarter of the latency.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate 30 models: 7 closed LLMs, 13 open LLMs read at the answer token, and 10 System-1 models.
